count_note: The summed pollutant training count reuses station-time observations across pollutants; it is not a distinct observation count.

limitations: Source-reported AQI, not reconstructed concentrations. No pollutant subindices or dominant pollutant in source.
Naive historical Pune times interpreted in Asia/Kolkata. Historical AQI is not a concentration training label.

industrial_exclusion_reason: Station coordinates absent; only one OSM tile available; 2026 geometry does not establish 2024-2025 factory presence. District 2021 emissions remain district aggregates.
limitations: No live data feed bundled. Current forecasts need caller-supplied recent observations.
Forecasts are at monitored station locations, not whole wards.
SO2 is a weak persistence baseline with negative test R2; NH3 and benzene explain little test variance.
No calibrated causal intervention effects or validated street-level predictions.
raw_count_note: Legacy AQI CSV table records contain multiple hourly AQI cells; raw CSV rows and unfolded observations are different measures.
